# Upstage Secures NVIDIA Investment in Series C

NVIDIA joins Amazon, AMD as investors in South Korea's first generative AI unicorn

[By Kim Kang-han](https://www.chosun.com/english/people/kim-kanghan/)

Published 2026.11.09. 17:23Updated 2026.11.09. 18:01

![업스테이지 로고. /업스테이지](https://www.chosun.com/resizer/v2/GM4WCZDEGVSTGMRWGFSDCYZVGU.png?auth=2f06a747a2ba94346d0b3d0693815104ca55267bc2b9f63461e278630a4351a9&width=616)

Upstage logo. /Upstage

AI startup Upstage has secured an investment from NVIDIA in its ongoing Series C Round 2.

Upstage announced on November 9, “Once this investment is finalized, Upstage will have global tech giants Amazon, AMD, and NVIDIA as investors.” It added, “In the first round of its Series C funding, which concluded in April and amounted to 180 billion Korean won, Upstage was valued at over 1 trillion Korean won, becoming South Korea’s first generative AI unicorn.”

Upstage independently developed large language models (LLMs) ‘Solar Pro 4’ and ‘Solar Mini 4.’ These models ranked among the top in terms of closed-model token usage on the global developer platform OpenRouter, marking the first time a domestic model achieved this.

Funds raised through the Series C round will be allocated to “enhancing proprietary AI models like Solar,” “recruiting key domestic and international talent,” and “expanding overseas market strategies in the U.S., Japan, and other regions.”

Upstage CEO Kim Sung-hun stated, “We are delighted to welcome NVIDIA as a new investor. Having proven that AI models developed in Korea can succeed globally, we will use this upcoming investment to further strengthen our AI model competitiveness and grow into a global AI leader.”
